root_text: Human metapneumovirus may only have been discovered in 2001, but it's older than that - here's a paper from @GauntLab from 2011 showing evidence that HMPV has been a human pathogen for decades before that https://t.co/6PBRt2exq7

nodes.author: DrCJ_Houldcroft
nodes.text: Human metapneumovirus may only have been discovered in 2001, but it's older than that - here's a paper from @GauntLab from 2011 showing evidence that HMPV has been a human pathogen for decades before that https://t.co/6PBRt2exq7

nodes.author: GauntLab
nodes.text: @DrCJ_Houldcroft My first, first author paper 🥰 well dug out! I loved it because that work -courtesy of senior author and clinical virologist @templeton_kate -  did a real world thing, it changed the respiratory screening panel at Edinburgh Royal, as it showed it was worth also testing for HMPV.

nodes.author: DrTregoning
nodes.text:
@GauntLab @DrCJ_Houldcroft @templeton_kate Was looking at last 3 years UKHSA data for this week.
it's basically exactly the same % all 3 years. Everything else shifting around a bit, really consistent basal level.

nodes.author: GauntLab
nodes.text: @DrTregoning @DrCJ_Houldcroft @templeton_kate Yeah I’m curious where the drama is coming from- is there a mutation in a surface protein increasing morbidity or something? (I’m currently on mat leave so zero idea what is happening in the real world 😂) why do we suddenly care about this ‘equilibrium’ virus

nodes.author: RTarlinton
nodes.text: @GauntLab @DrTregoning @DrCJ_Houldcroft @templeton_kate Congrats on the maternity leave too Elly! Mine are teens now. I love this phase, hated the baby bit…

nodes.text: @RTarlinton @DrTregoning @DrCJ_Houldcroft @templeton_kate Thank you! Hah I think you’re the first I’ve heard say they love teenager phase! I am loving baby phase-dressing him in all the animal clothes, talking in noises and watching anything Attenborough :)

nodes.author: DrCJ_Houldcroft
nodes.text: @GauntLab @DrTregoning @templeton_kate I assume China are having the spike we had in December 2021 (?) and are just making a big noise, as they did over Mycoplasma this time last year...

nodes.author: RTarlinton
nodes.text: @DrCJ_Houldcroft @GauntLab @DrTregoning @templeton_kate I think it’s got more to do with general panickyness post covid over respiratory viruses … a “ new mystery virus out of China” makes good click bait ….

nodes.text: @GauntLab @templeton_kate Found it on Google scholar and thought "I know those authors!"

nodes.author: DrTregoning
nodes.text: @DrCJ_Houldcroft @GauntLab I saw someone say it was discovered over a quarter of a century ago, and my response was it was only discovered in 2001 and then I cried a bit because I felt really old.
